edges.label: Project Stork / Blue Book Special Report No. 14 produced here
edges.note: TIER 3, INFERENTIAL, and the reason is worth stating. Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, the statistical analysis of 1947-1952 sighting reports dated 5 May 1955, is attributed on its own title page to the Air Technical Intelligence Center at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, under Project No. 10073. Its summary says the study 'was prepared by a panel of scientists both in and out of the Air Force'. The released copy names no contractor at all: a full-text scan of all 313 pages finds no occurrence of 'Battelle', 'Columbus' or 'Memorial Institute'. The Columbus tie rests entirely on the secondary literature's Battelle attribution, which the primary record does not make.

edges.label: Stork was Blue Book's contracted analytical arm
edges.note: The Air Force's public UFO project outsourced its own analytical methodology to a private nonprofit, whose records were never federal records.
